baseline_evidence.measurementScope: Ordinary SampleScene and production roster. Title New Game and developer player AI (fixed intelligence 15). Enemy threat/personality are recorded per match. Fixed map and commander seeds; no AP, resources, timer, timeScale or thinking-budget overrides. Frame scheduling/search limits can still affect exact trajectories. Observer reads authoritative HP/decisive identity for reporting only, never supplies hidden information to AI. CommanderHP follows MatchObjectiveRules.IsCommander, including Kind.Boss primary commanders. Legacy KingHP fields alias CommanderHP. VictoryObjectiveAttacks match actual opposing commander/main-crystal life IDs, not the Reflection role string Boss.
